title: Make AAPSClient visually distinguishable from AAPS on Wear OS
symptom: AAPSClient on WearOS uses the same name and icon as the regular AAPS, resulting in confusing UX when both apps are installed side by side. The same issue exists in complication picker.
evidence_quote: AAPSClient on WearOS uses the same name and icon as the regular AAPS, resulting in confusing UX when both apps are installed side by side.
